title: Introduction to Agentic Coding
description: Learn how AI coding agents go beyond suggestions — planning, executing multi-step tasks, and building features autonomously with human oversight.

data.text: Agentic coding represents the next evolution of AI-assisted development. Instead of suggesting one line at a time, AI agents can plan multi-step implementations, create files, run tests, and iterate on errors — all with appropriate human oversight.
